items.design: Compact fitted polished moonsteel cuirass with plain rounded pauldrons, dark leather underlayers, a diagonal leather buckle strap, narrow brass edges; practical clean elegant low-tier silhouette, NO gem.

Distinctive elegant jade-knight breastplate with overlapping pointed leaf-shaped shoulder plates, cream silver chest, delicate gold vine filigree, green enamel collar and small emerald clasp, tapered waist.
Royal azure drake armor: angular silver-blue lamellar torso, long swept-back wing-like pauldrons, sapphire diamond breast emblem, delicate champagne-gold engraved ribs, regal high-tier geometry.

A complete elaborate silver and gold necklace with a large elongated azure hexagonal sapphire, suspended inside an open six-pointed geometric star cage, two small blue side stones, refined angular chain links.

A complete midnight-silver necklace with a faceted marquise amethyst pendant suspended inside intertwined silver crescent moons, three delicate hanging points and an angular articulated silver chain; graceful high fantasy couture.

A complete spectacular celestial coronation necklace: large cushion-cut crimson ruby held inside an intricate champagne-gold seraphic sunburst cage, triple-spire crest above the ruby, three graduated gold chains, small ivory diamond side stones. Strong luxurious high-tier silhouette.

One spectacular celestial sovereign ring viewed three-quarter with clear finger hole, large brilliant cushion-cut crimson ruby, sculpted open-wing champagne-gold shoulders, triple-spire mini crest gallery, fine ivory diamond accents; highest-tier luxury but keep a graceful wearable band, not a chunky toy.
